key: So I was just sitting there, enjoying a nice warm cup of Cherubi Mint Tea, and then suddenly, literally ALL the furniture in my apartment just disappeared.
en: So I was just sitting there, enjoying a nice warm cup of Cherubi Mint Tea, and then suddenly, literally ALL the furniture in my apartment just disappeared.
ja: あたたかい チェリンボミントティーを 楽しんで 座っていたら　突然 部屋の家具が 文字どおり 全部 消えたんだ

key: Even the chair I was sitting on!
en: Even the chair I was sitting on!
ja: 座っていた イスまで!

key: I fell to the ground instantly and spilled tea all over myself!
en: I fell to the ground instantly and spilled tea all over myself!
ja: そのまま 床に落ちて 紅茶を 全身に かぶったよ!

key: This whole town has gone mad!
en: This whole town has gone mad!
ja: この町は まるごと 狂ってる!

key: I've been trying to find a pattern in the strange apparition.
en: I've been trying to find a pattern in the strange apparition.
ja: この奇妙な 出現に 法則がないか 調べているんだ

key: Or disapparition, as the case may be.
en: Or disapparition, as the case may be.
ja: あるいは 消失と 言うべきかな

key: As far as I can tell though, nothing is being created or destroyed, only moved around.
en: As far as I can tell though, nothing is being created or destroyed, only moved around.
ja: だが 見るかぎり 何も 生まれても 壊れてもいない　ただ 移動しているだけだ

key: So all of this-- whatever this chaos is-- is just some sort of teleportation gimmick.
en: So all of this-- whatever this chaos is-- is just some sort of teleportation gimmick.
ja: つまり この混乱は 一種の テレポートの 仕掛けなんだ

key: Or so I think.
en: Or so I think.
ja: ……と 僕は 思っている

key: But there's no way for me to tell when or where it's going to strike next.
en: But there's no way for me to tell when or where it's going to strike next.
ja: だが 次に いつ どこで 起きるかは 分からない

key: Ultimately, these random happenstances, though strange, are inconsequential.
en: Ultimately, these random happenstances, though strange, are inconsequential.
ja: 結局のところ こうした 偶然の出来事は 奇妙ではあるが 取るに足らない

key: The wheel of fate turns in unseen ways, always.
en: The wheel of fate turns in unseen ways, always.
ja: 運命の輪は いつも 見えぬ形で 回っている

key: This, we knew.
en: This, we knew.
ja: それは 前から 知っていたこと

key: This is simply one more rotation.
en: This is simply one more rotation.
ja: これも ただ 一回の 回転にすぎない

key: At least the disappearing things are entertaining and whimsical.
en: At least the disappearing things are entertaining and whimsical.
ja: 物が 消えるのは まあ 面白くて 気まぐれで いいけどね

key: But the earthquakes are just jarring.
en: But the earthquakes are just jarring.
ja: でも 地震は ただ 不快なだけだよ

key: Ack!
en: Ack!
ja: うわっ!

key: My Pokémon are disobeying me again!
en: My Pokémon are disobeying me again!
ja: ポケモンが また 言うことを 聞かない!

key: How did I accidentally overlevel?!
en: How did I accidentally overlevel?!
ja: うっかり レベルを 上げすぎたのか?!

key: Dang, last time someone asked me for a password, I should've told them "hardcap"!
en: Dang, last time someone asked me for a password, I should've told them "hardcap"!
ja: くそっ この前 パスワードを 聞かれた時 「hardcap」と 答えておくんだった!

key: That would've stopped my Pokémon from gaining EXP at a certain level instead of disobeying!
en: That would've stopped my Pokémon from gaining EXP at a certain level instead of disobeying!
ja: そうすれば 言うことを 聞かなくなる代わりに 一定レベルで 経験値が 止まったのに!

key: Drat!
en: Drat!
ja: ちくしょう!

key: Then again, they say the EXP All will do that too when it's turned on...
en: Then again, they say the EXP All will do that too when it's turned on...
ja: とはいえ みんなのがくしゅうそうちを オンにしても 同じことに なるらしいけど……

key: Dang!
en: Dang!
ja: くそっ!

key: Just gotta get me one!
en: Just gotta get me one!
ja: とにかく 手に入れなきゃ!
